summary.intent: Push caliper toward a v1 alpha by creating and executing six planned Entire trails (benchmarking, perf, detection, release flow), then explore the benchmark library, article and diagram ideas, and the Oxc/TS 7.1/tsrs landscape for caliper's architecture.
summary.outcome: Created trails #153-#158, ran parallel workers, and pushed stacked draft PRs #280-#283 for oracle and weekly-pairing work; perf and release-flow branches were built locally by workers. Diagnosed a release race, confirmed Callisto 0.16.0 is current, and found Oxc's tsrs checker plus ADR 0026, which is still Proposed and awaiting the user's decision.

repo: Nothing in the repo defined 'v1 alpha'; the plan lives outside the repo at ~/.claude/projects/-Users-gabe-Projects-caliper/plan/next-trails-2026-11-02.md so any session can read it without a branch.
Entire auto-opens PRs when a branch is pushed and linked to a trail; PR bodies must keep the Entire marker when edited. Stacked branches need to be linked with --base <parent> before any PR exists.
Stacked PRs auto-close or strand content when a parent merges and its branch is deleted, so merge bottom-up and check bases before opening.
Release failure E148 ('release PR snapshot changed') is a race in the Callisto release-PR step. A re-run or the next push fixes it. Callisto does not recommend a retry step.

Callisto 0.16.0 attestation checks expect a signer workflow named callisto-release.yml, so release.yml would need renaming. This is unconfirmed in source. GitHub Releases attach to the product package's own tag (cargo/caliper-docgen@x.y.z), and the product package must be Cargo (E304).
The Homebrew tap reads tags like npm/caliper-docgen@x.y.z, so tag-template must stay unset.

The Storybook addon defaults to collapseInheritedProps 'none' (packages/storybook/src/provider.ts:69), but measurements used the CLI default. Storybook-specific claims and trail 192's premise are unverified.
Oracle numbers are unreliable until fixed: PRs #318/#320 have a verdict key mismatch (less_precise vs 'less precise'), a sample clamped under 50 reported as 50, and dropped --list entries.

The weekly record uses pinned corpora and a versioned reference (reference_version) so results are reproducible. Local runs on unpinned checkouts differ (Spectrum wrong-rate 11.79% locally vs 1.09% in CI).
react-docgen's default importer follows imports (fsImporter); the old 'reads each file alone' claim in docs was wrong. react-docgen throws on 17-21% of files.
Under the sandbox, tsx fails on its IPC socket (EPERM); `node src/oracle.ts` works because Node 26 strips types. The job tmp dir is write-denied, so use $TMPDIR.

Oxc has a Rust TypeScript 7 checker, oxc-project/tsrs. ADR 0026 (Proposed) makes the checker the type authority with structural as fallback, in slices S1-S8; S4 and later must not start until the user accepts it.

code.finding: Storybook addon defaults collapseInheritedProps to 'none', unlike the CLI default, so benchmarks must use the addon's real config.
Function-marker rule now caps only a parameter marker (optional/rest) that the tool lost: (kp.optional && !cp.optional) || (kp.rest && !cp.rest).
Repeats the incorrect 'reads each file alone' wording about react-docgen.

friction: `entire brain brief` failed on a sandbox write-lock denial under ~/.local/share/entire/ and was never retried.
Reports from the callisto-gap and mine-entire agents were truncated and needed resends.
My earlier searches missed tsrs and I wrongly said Oxc had no checker until the user pushed back.
Machine load of 9-15 made uncontended perf measurement impossible, so the perf branches don't show they reach the 141 ms / 275 MiB baseline.
Weekly pairing reached 92.1% antd recall, not the ~95% target, and the fix/weekly-caliper-key-collisions branch was skipped.
Trail bodies did not render tables, and stacked merges stranded content in #281 and #283.
open_items: User decision: accept ADR 0026 so slices S4-S8 can start; review #392 and the spike's time-to-first-answer and memory figures first.
Trail 158 release flow: decide on renaming release.yml to callisto-release.yml, whether to add an E148 retry, and ask the Homebrew tap owner before merging. Rehearse on a scratch repo or fork.
Trail 154 perf: only two of three branches were built (the cache-react-augmentations branch was deleted). The 141 ms / 275 MiB baseline is not reached.
oracle/three-tools-report is on hold until PRs #280-#283 merge; trails 155 then 156 are a serial stack that hasn't started, and trail 157 hasn't started either.
Spectrum's 1.09% oracle wrong-rate is uninvestigated, and Mantine, Chakra and Spectrum need a CI weekly run to validate the new pairing and oracle rules.
Fix the #318/#320 defects, then redo the collapse and checker-mode measurements with the addon's real configuration; tell the owner of trail 192 that its premise needs re-checking.

Write the techworx article in ~/projects/pages (MDX, draft: true) with a claims ledger and diagrams (hybrid architecture, ramp timeline, data flow). Its thesis may shift given tsrs. Awaiting a go-ahead and title.
Plan the shared benchmark library (a packages/bench trail): harden the reference sample, define adapter and report schemas, consolidate weekly.py into TypeScript, and decide the licence.
Read the TS 7.1 Beta post and typescript-go API PRs (#4699, #4712), and search Oxc's GitHub for checker discussion.
apps/validate/ remains untracked and its baselines were modified.
